newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices gained sharply on higher demand from overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Buyers for Pakistan, Poland and Afghanistan lifted most of teas on offer, pushing the prices of most grades up.
Some 1.2 million kg of teas were sold at the auction.
The average price was 49.56 taka per kg, up 2.31 taka from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on December 31 with an expected offer of 975,000 kg.
